title: PAF Airman Recruitment 2026: Trades, Eligibility and Selection
metaDescription: Complete guide to Pakistan Air Force Airman recruitment 2026: eligible trades, age and education requirements, selection centres, tests, medical standards
headline: Join PAF as an Airman: 2026 Recruitment Guide

sections.title: Who Can Apply as a PAF Airman
sections.content:
Pakistan Air Force recruits airmen in several trades, including Aero Technician, Provost, Ground Combatier, Mechanical Transport Driver, and other technical and non-technical trades. Applicants are generally unmarried male citizens of Pakistan, and the age limits and education requirements vary by trade, so candidates should check the official advertisement for their chosen trade.

Most technical trades require Matric Science with good marks in Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics, while some trades accept Matric in any stream or require a valid driving licence. Candidates from Azad Kashmir and Gilgit-Baltistan are also eligible under the same national recruitment rules.

sections.title: Selection Process and Tests
sections.content:
Selection begins with online registration followed by reporting to a PAF Information and Selection Centre for an intelligence test and an academic test in subjects such as English, Physics and Mathematics. Candidates who pass the written tests are shortlisted for a preliminary medical examination and an interview with selection officers.

Successful candidates then appear before the Air Headquarters selection board for a final interview and medical examination. The process also includes document verification, and candidates must bring original certificates, national identity cards and domicile documents to every stage.

sections.title: Medical and Physical Standards
sections.content:
Airman candidates must meet PAF medical standards covering vision, hearing, height, weight and general physical fitness, with trade-specific requirements for some roles such as drivers and combat trades. Candidates with certain medical conditions may be declared unfit, although some cases are reviewed by specialist medical boards.

Physical fitness is assessed through running and basic fitness activities, and candidates are advised to train regularly before reporting. Maintaining a healthy weight, good eyesight habits and regular exercise improves the chances of clearing both the medical and fitness stages.

sections.title: Training and Career Growth
sections.content:
Selected airmen undergo basic training at the PAF training base in Kohat, where they learn military discipline, drill, physical training, weapon handling and service subjects. After basic training, airmen proceed to trade training schools to learn the technical skills of their allotted trade.

The PAF offers a structured career with regular promotions, trade courses, free medical facilities for the family, accommodation and opportunities for further education. Hardworking airmen can rise through the ranks and, in some trades, later qualify for commissioned officer courses through internal selection.

faqs.q: What is the age limit for PAF Airman recruitment 2026?
faqs.a: The age limit for most airman trades is generally between sixteen and twenty years, although the exact limit varies by trade and is announced in each recruitment advertisement. Candidates should verify the cut-off date in the official notice, since age is calculated against a specific date given by the PAF.

faqs.q: What education is needed to become a PAF Airman?
faqs.a: Most technical trades require Matric Science with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics, while some non-technical trades accept Matric in other streams. Certain trades, such as Mechanical Transport Driver, additionally require a valid driving licence, so candidates must check the trade-specific education criteria carefully.

faqs.q: What tests are included in PAF Airman selection?
faqs.a: Selection includes an intelligence test, an academic test in English, Physics and Mathematics, a preliminary medical examination and an interview at the selection centre. Shortlisted candidates then face a final interview and medical examination at the Air Headquarters selection board before merit lists are prepared.

faqs.q: Where does PAF Airman training take place?
faqs.a: Basic training for selected airmen takes place at the PAF training base in Kohat, covering discipline, drill, physical training, weapon handling and service subjects. After basic training, airmen move to trade training schools to learn the technical skills required for their allotted trade.
